thread:
Marta: Heads-up 1: I'm trialing a tiny handoff + feedback microcard for cross-team work. Goal: make post-sprint handoffs and async feedback one-line so they actually happen. Pasteable below.

Devon: Nice, we always lose context in handoffs. Can you show both the IC handoff and the reviewer feedback one-liner?

Marta: Sure 1: IC handoff card (single Slack message):
```
Handoff: <what was done, 1 line>
Owner: <who owns next steps>
Outcome: <one-line metric or user outcome>
Artifacts: <link>
Confidence: <high/med/low>
Blocker (opt): <one-line>
```

Marta: Reviewer/peer feedback one-liner to paste in threads: "Seen: <impact>. Example: <brief concrete example>. Next: <one-sentence suggestion/help>. Confidence: <agree/ask for followup>."

Leo: Love the Confidence flag 1: helps triage who needs follow-up. Could we have a manager micro-note also? e.g., readiness to ship / needed support.

Marta: Yep — manager micro-note (copyable):
```
Manager note: Ready to transition? <yes/no>. Risks: <short>. Support: <what I will provide>. Calibration: <low/med/high evidence>.
```

Sasha: Can we make a one-line "handoff acceptance" reply so owners can ack quickly?

Marta: Good call. Handoff ack line: "Acked: I accept next steps + will update artifact by <date>. Confidence: <high/med/low>."

Devon: This is great. If we put the artifacts link as a single bullet that should help reviewers jump in. Also suggest a tiny CSV export so Product can bulk-import to handoff tracker.

peopleops-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/handoff-feedback-microcards-v1.txt (org) :white_check_mark:

Marta: Added a CSV template and a short FAQ in the drive file explaining how to use Confidence and Calibration tags. Will pilot with two teams next week.

Leo: I'll try the ack line in my squad's handoff channel and report back results after one sprint.

Sasha: Thanks! If this reduces follow-up meetings by one per sprint, i'll be very happy. :smile:
